experiment: Perform two cold, read-only ZIP-mounted DOSBox-X boots with the empty input tape and reduce each log through the exact start marker.

observations.finding: Both boots execute TOMB.EXE and its archive-contained DOS4GW.EXE support program.
Both boots reach the same VESA mode 0x69 reset and post-reset 640x480 surface event sequence.
The two canonical reduced traces are byte-identical with SHA-256 8b7b423a4a592657926429d8962564afb32a69ed59579dcc5bd6d7e9816f55fe.
DOSBox-X applies a 4:3 surface policy; emulator timing and rasterization are not original-hardware facts.

conclusion: The frozen cold-boot procedure is repeatable through m0-boot-complete-v1.
limits: The concrete full demo-completion trace signature is deferred
No LEVEL2.PHD semantic analysis was performed
downstreamTests: npm run gate:m0 repeatable reduced boot trace check
